Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.blob.event_age
Metrics.Description: Freshest blob event age this tick — the metric propagation floor (#128).

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.blob.metric_emitted
Metrics.Description: Blob records that reached the metrics path (#128).

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.blob.metric_gated
Metrics.Description: Blob records too old for the metrics path, taken log-only (#128).

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.blob.records_dropped
Metrics.Description: Blob records dropped because they had no parseable event time (#275).

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.blob.self_excluded
Metrics.Description: Blob records dropped by exclude_self because their appId matched the poller's proved authenticated application ID (#154).
